events.title: Up-Beat!! demo Week 1 Patch Now Available!
events.summary: The Up-Beat!! demo week 1 patch is now available! PATCH NOTES New features: -Precise speedrun timer on results screen -Gamepad joystick support -"Motion" window in state editor with x and y offsets and squash/stretch, and introduces character shake, screen shake, and sine wave movement. All of these can be set to play once or loop when the fighter's animation loops. -Checkbox in editor to show a preview of Ray's position for reference -Ability to skip the results screen drum roll Bug fixes: -Fix
